title: Bypass an exposed field
explanation: LeakyShelf.addTopic rejects blank text, but the public list lets a caller insert an empty string directly. final prevents reassigning the list reference; it does not prevent changing the list.

title: Validate through an operation
explanation: ReadingShelf owns a private list and a positive capacity. addTopic("") is rejected before mutation, so the valid Objects topic remains the only entry.

title: Keep the returned snapshot separate
explanation: getTopics returns an unmodifiable snapshot. Attempting snapshot.add("") throws UnsupportedOperationException and leaves the shelf unchanged.

title: Preserve both the snapshot and the invariant
explanation: Adding Interfaces through the shelf is valid. The earlier snapshot stays unchanged. A third topic exceeds capacity and is rejected without changing the two accepted topics.
